connector.name: Formpaste
connector.registryDescription: Create and wire up contact forms from your coding agent. Forms, snippets, and submissions.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.formpaste.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package formpaste-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.formpaste, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer fpat_ token minted in the Formpaste dashboard under Settings -> API & MCP.

env.name: FORMPASTE_TOKEN
env.description: Formpaste API token starting with fpat_, minted in the dashboard under Settings -> API & MCP. Use a setup-scoped token unless the agent needs to read submission content.
